0022600133.text: The Wizards (2-2) visit Cleveland for their fifth game of the season, sitting third in the Southeast and 1 game back in the division, 9th in the East, and coming off a loss. Cleveland (2-1) is 2-0 at home, has won two straight, and sits second in the Central, 0.5 games back. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4 and fell 130-117 in their last meeting, in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
